title: Honour tenant AI settings: humanConfirmRequired, redactPiiBeforeModel, maxTokensPerClaim
story: As a carrier admin I want my tenant AI settings to actually govern model use so that human review, PII protection and cost caps are enforced.
acceptance: With tenant ai.humanConfirmRequired=true, every cascade.run result (including high-confidence ones that return early) carries unconfirmed:true; with false/absent behaviour is unchanged (tests in tests/unit/ai/settings.test.mjs).

With ai.redactPiiBeforeModel=true, guardrail PII redaction is applied for every provider including local; default is true for cloud providers and unchanged for local when unset; explicit false is honoured for local only (test asserts provider receives redacted input).

ai.maxTokensPerClaim: usage tokens per claim are summed from ai_inference; once the budget is exceeded the next run skips cloud entries, falls back to the local provider and returns unconfirmed:true; budget is per tenant and per claim and does not leak across tenants (test).
Existing tests still pass: node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/ai/ ; docs/ai-evaluation.md documents the three settings and defaults.
brief: Edit src/ai/cascade.mjs (read aiConfig = ctx.tenants.get(tenantId).ai at run()), src/ai/guardrails.mjs (guard(provider, opts) currently redacts only for cloud; add a forceRedact option, and make cascade wrap with it from aiConfig.redactPiiBeforeModel; default true for non-local), src/ai/inference-log.mjs (add a tenant-scoped helper tokensForClaim(tenantId, claimId) summing usage input+output tokens; usage is stored as JSON text; add an optional claim_id handling only via the existing usage JSON or a backward-compatible additive migration with CREATE/ALTER guarded, since ai_inference has no claim column today - prefer storing claimId inside usage JSON to avoid a schema change and query with json_extract or by scanning recent rows). Pass opts.claimId from callers (document it in src/ai/index.mjs header; do not edit other teams' modules). Pitfalls: the early return in run() when confidence >= threshold must also apply humanConfirmRequired; the budget fallback should reuse resolveChain filtered to provider==='local' and still log to ai_inference with usage.skipped:'budget'; cascade wraps injected test providers unguarded, so make forceRedact apply in the cascade for injected ones too only when redactPiiBeforeModel===true explicitly. Use ctx.db.forTenant(tenantId) only; never raw input in logs. Use small fake providers and a fake ctx in tests; do not touch src/modules/evidence. Document in docs/ai-evaluation.md. If core ctx lacks tenants.get shape you need, post a contract-change request to the architecture hub.
requirements: PII never reaches cloud model unredacted
